answers.core: This is a change that would need to happen in `Node3D`/`Node2D` code, in order for all relevant inheriting nodes to benefit from. Can't be done outside of core.
answers.workaround:
Yes/no, the least-bad workaround so far seems to be to add a child `Node3D` with a script to the `Path3D` with `set_notify_transform(true)` and a `_notification()` override that emits the desired signal - then listen to that signal from any scripts that only should run when the transform gets changed.

The inclusion of an extra node in there, only to add a kind of proxy signal adds clutter to the node hierarchy, and it seems fundamentally wrong to require a *separate* node to exist in order to listen to the state changes of its *parent* node.

title: Add opt-in signal for Node2D/3D transform changes
